QuestInfo.name: Dawnveil Explorer
QuestInfo.0: Learn more about Dawnveil, the newly-discovered land of gold!
QuestInfo.1: #b#e#p9010000##k#n says that a new continent's been discovered to the south of Ossyria, past the Tynerum barrier. She says that she checked the Helios Tower Library for information about the new continent, but some monsters stole the documents. Make a name for yourself as a #e#b#t1142663##k#n by retrieving those documents from the monsters.\r\n#y17219# #b#R17218##k/10
